description: Deterministically repair mechanical FlowZap Code errors: non-sequential node numbering, inferred edge handles, node/edge label syntax (label:"…" on nodes vs [label="…"] on edges), missing lane display labels, emoji and non-printable characters. Returns the repaired code plus the list of applied corrections. Errors that cannot be repaired are reported as-is — the repairer never invents content. Run flowzap_validate on the repaired code afterwards.
name: flowzap_fix
